norwegian_comparison.description: Three excerpts from distinct Norwegian meeting recordings; 300 seconds of source audio per model.
norwegian_comparison.interpretation: Large-v3 passed timed speech-coverage checks on all three excerpts. NB-Whisper had timestamp/coverage failures on the affected excerpt, so it remains opt-in. No Norwegian word-error-rate or general accuracy claim is made.

english_smoke_test.description: 32-word known reference synthesized locally using macOS say, tested in English and Auto-detect modes.
english_smoke_test.interpretation: Both modes completed with normalized word error rate 0 on this short fixture; this is not a general English accuracy benchmark.

unresolved_ranges.reason: Detected speech has no corresponding transcript

full_recording_regression.coverage_gap_recovered: A gap around 14:34–14:38 triggered smaller-section retries and was resolved.
full_recording_regression.resume_validation: Completed sections were reused; only the unresolved final part was retranscribed.
full_recording_regression.interpretation: Useful timed text is recovered through approximately 38:51. The final seconds are explicitly flagged for review rather than reported as complete.

automated_checks.cargo_clippy: passed with 20 pre-existing warnings outside the new transcription code

limitations: Coverage and repetition checks cannot establish that every word is correct.
